title: ID0384644-DC/Si-D/FR- [IlzNRX] Power consumed more than EV capacity
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We have a customer who complain about of his charging session. At the beginning his SOC was 9% and he finished at 100%. His vehicle was KIA EV6 which has 77kWh of capacity. He consumed 77,4 kWh during his charging session. Could you explain why he consumed more than the capacity of his vehicle with a start at 9% please ? His RFID tag was C4C9EFDA .
Root cause: Power consumed by CAR Cooling Unit
Solution: Answer provided to customer.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0384644-DC/Si-D/FR- [IlzNRX] Power consumed more than EV capacity CRM:00796000869
additional_info.body:
Hi Bastien Bonhomme,
We apologize for the delay in our response. We conducted a detailed log analysis for this charging session and did not find any faults in the amount of power delivered to the EV. The power delivered to the vehicle was 77.4 kW during this charging session while the EV was connected at a state of charge (SOC) of 9%. The remaining power was used by the vehicle's cooling unit for BMS or aux. supply. We request you to please confirm the same with the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
